verdict.rationale: Datalab documents an extract-structured-data endpoint: you provide a JSON schema and Marker parses the document and fills in that schema with extracted values. It adds citations back to source bounding boxes and can reuse checkpoints to skip re-parsing. missing for 10: explicit documentation that returned fields are validated against the schema, independent or hands-on corroboration of extraction quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I supply a JSON schema and get back validated structured fields extracted from the document

citations.quote: Extract specific fields from documents by providing a JSON schema. Marker parses the document and fills in your schema with extracted values.
Extract structured data from a document using a JSON schema.
Extract specific fields with citations back to source bounding boxes for auditability
Provide a file for end-to-end processing, or a checkpoint_id from a previous /convert call to skip re-parsing.
